faction:thousand-sons|Cabal of Sorcerers.text: If your Army Faction is THOUSAND SONS, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals from those listed below.

To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test for that model by following the sequence below.
Psychic Test Sequence
Roll 2D6
Channel the Warp (Optional)
Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result.
If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.
*FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): Do I need to sequence all of my Cabal of Sorcerers Rituals at the start of my Shooting phase?
No, you just pick a model with the Cabal of Sorcerers rule, pick a Ritual to manifest, and attempt it, then repeat the process until you have run out of models or Rituals or both.*
*FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): When using the Cabal of Sorcerers army rule, do I have to choose whether to Channel the Warp before rolling any dice?
No.*
*FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): When using the Cabal of Sorcerers army rule, if I roll one or more doubles or triples, does my model only suffer D3 mortal wounds if I chose to Channel the Warp?
Yes.*

conditions.v: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot.

At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the ka'tah abilities presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied. Each ka'tah ability will tell you when that ka'tah ability can be used, and the effects that ka'tah ability has on the unit using it. We recommend placing a token next to each readied unit, removing it when that unit is no longer readied. Favoured Ka'tah All detachments tagged 'Unique: Shield Host' state a Favoured Ka'tah. If you selected one of these detachments, the ka'tah ability that is the Favoured Ka'tah of that detachment grants the additional effect listed in that detachment. Example: If you selected the Solar Watch detachment, when you select the Calistus ka'tah ability for a readied unit, that unit has +2" M in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.
